_about: Each reference's recorded product against the official reaction equation in UniProt/Rhea. Nothing is corrected here; disagreements are reported.
_why: The oxygen fate of choline monooxygenase was recorded wrongly twice, because the balance was computed from the dehydrated equilibrium form instead of the product the enzyme actually releases.
